{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A refined silk-blend blouse with a relaxed collar, straight cut, length hitting at the hip, ivory white (#fffff0), soft drape.
Tailored wool crepe trousers, wide-leg silhouette, ankle-length hem, charcoal grey (#36454f), structured weave.
A textured camel overcoat, single-breasted cut, knee-length, warm camel brown (#c19a6b), heavy knit fabric.
Leather loafers with a slight heel, rounded toe, classic tan (#d2b48c), smooth calfskin leather.
Thin tortoiseshell acetate glasses, rectangular frame, neutral amber-tinted lenses, lightweight plastic.
This ensemble works perfectly for an autumn morning at the office because the tailored trousers and refined blouse maintain a professional "neat" aesthetic while allowing comfortable walking through potential rain. The camel coat provides essential warmth without sacrificing style, acting as a sophisticated outer layer that transitions seamlessly from desk work to a brief outdoor walk. The neutral color palette of ivory, charcoal, and tan complements her skin tone while ensuring she looks polished and ready for the day ahead."}
